minutes.headline: Committee reorganized, approved capital transfers for Turkey Hill asbestos, tables and a tractor, and backed a memorial building.
minutes.summary: Reorganization meeting: officers chosen, subcommittee and delegate assignments made, and standing authorizations approved. The superintendent and business manager proposed a line-item transfer of energy savings to three capital items. Presentations followed on a memorial building project, a lifelong learning partnership, and school handbooks and improvement plans, plus a student trip approval.

what_happened.line: The School Committee reorganized, choosing officers and making subcommittee and delegate assignments; the minutes show the opening votes only in part.
The superintendent and business manager proposed moving energy savings into three more capital items: Turkey Hill asbestos tile abatement, picnic tables and tractor equipment.
A waiver allowing food and beverages in the middle high school auditorium for annual town meeting passed.
The committee heard a memorial building project presentation and took a vote to let it proceed; the outcome was not audible in the captions.
Handbook and improvement plan votes and initial approval of the LHS trip were taken, but the outcomes were not audible.

why_it_matters: The energy-savings transfer pays for school building work from existing operating savings rather than a new appropriation, so it bears on how far facilities money goes in the town budget, mostly taxes.
Several votes, including the memorial building and the LHS trip, have no audible outcome in the captions, so the official minutes are needed to confirm what was decided.
